 Ambush skill: fixed a bug that prevented the Invisible effect from being removed.
 Healing Touch skill: fixed a bug that allowed the skill to affect all operators around the target.
 Support Tower, upgrade #14-1: fixed a bug that caused the actual healing bonus to be lower than listed in the description.


MAPS, MODES AND BOTS


 Radar map: added to Frontline and Threshold modes.

 Frozen Town map: fixed a bug that prevented the mini-map from being displayed while loading in several modes.
 Frozen Town map: fixed the cafe building’s collision.
 Crossing map, Ranked Battles mode: fixed several spots where climbing and jumping off objects worked incorrectly.
 Radar map, Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: removed the sniper bot from the helicopter.
 Radar map, Frontline and Threshold modes: fixed a bug that caused several invisible objects to appear on the map.
 Threshold, Heavy Fighter bot: fixed a bug that prevented the bomb detonation acceleration bonus from resetting after destroying the enemy’s AA systems.

 Prologue: fixed several bugs related to bot actions.

notes.title: Update 0.22.1: patch note
notes.content:
The New Year version turned out to be large. We added the Knights of the Crown Battle Pass with SAS operators, Caliber+, player statistics, a new mission for the Radar map, a new map Frozen Town; conducted a rebalance of various maps and fixed a lot of bugs. And there’s more.

Learn more about the update from a patch note.

GENERAL CHANGES


 Added the new SAS collection
 Added the Knights of the Crown Battle Pass.
 Added Caliber+.
 Added player statistics.
 Began the Snowy Shop event.
 Prepared the fourth season of Twitch Drops: Operation Snowfall.
 Added a new mission on the Radar map.
 Added the new Frozen Town map for Showdown, Annihilation and Ranked Battle (Hacking) modes.
 Carried out operator rebalancing. Added the new Weak Sprint mechanic.
 Rebalanced six maps in PvP modes.
 Onslaught mode: fixed several errors in the final cutscenes.
 Changed some operators’ upgrade icons.
 Ranked Battle: fixed a bug that allowed entering the mode with one Level 10+ operator.
 Replays, gamepad controls: fixed a bug that prevented scrolling through lists in menus with the analog stick during a replay.
 Operator upgrades: corrected upgrade descriptions for some operators.
 All modes: fixed a bug that prevented the camera from automatically switching to an ally after the player had been executed.
 Ranked Battle: fixed a bug that prevented players from changing their choice during the Picks and Bans stage.
 Fixed incorrect visuals on the Winter HQ Background.


Effects:


 Medic Travnik, primary weapon: decreased the amount of gunpowder clouds from shots.
 Onslaught mode, sapper robot: added the visual damage resistance effect.
 Green laser designators: fixed a bug that caused the aiming dot to display as a semi-circle.
 The Weapon of Victory HQ background: fixed a bug that caused the wrong lightning to appear on the HQ background.
 Onslaught and Annihilation modes: fixed a bug that prevented the indication of an activated Field Bonus.
 Fixed the incorrect display of operators’ XP gauges filling up on the Operators screen.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the visual effect of the incendiary cartridges to disappear.
 Replays. Fixed incorrect positions of some of the HUD elements.
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to report themselves.


OPERATORS

Check out a detailed description of the operator changes in a separate article: RE: Balance.

MODELS AND OUTFITS:


 Medic Bard (Ice-Breaker Epic Outfit): fixed the incorrect hand position while firing the primary weapon in aiming mode.
 Medic Karavai (Afghan Legendary Outfit): fixed the incorrect hand position while firing the primary weapon in aiming mode.
 Assault Corsair (Jolly Roger Epic Outfit), Assault Faro (Pyro Epic Outfit): fixed the incorrect display of the primary weapon’s reticle.
 Assault Plut (Doppelgänger Epic Outfit): fixed the outfit’s model.
 Assault Starkaðr (Woodward Legendary Outfit): corrected the standard scope model (without upgrade #2).


Changed the angle of the secondary weapon field of vision for the following outfits:


 Alpha — Mermen Legendary Outfits.
 SSO — all outfits.

 GROM — Beluga Legendary Outfits.
 KSK — standard outfits.
 EZAPAC — standard outfits.
 SSO RB — standard outfits.
 AMF — standard outfits.

Perun, Alpha


 Fixed a bug that caused the Snug Fit skill to work permanently without the Basic Reserve Stock Increase upgrade. The skill should work only while the operator’s armor is full.

 The Dead Calm ability: fixed a bug that prevented the alternative ability usage from destroying Marksman Vagabond’s Parkan drone.
 The Dead Calm ability: fixed a bug that prevented the ability from cancelling Assault Sterling’s Unfinished Business ability’s effect.

 Primary weapon: fixed a bug that caused the aiming point and bullet entry point to not align correctly.
 Corrected the descriptions of upgrade #8-2.


Kurt, KSK


 Primary weapon: fixed visual errors in the scope models.


Bones, CST


 Upgrade #9-2: Fixed a bug that caused the Buddy drone to destroy projectiles while broken.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Buddy drone to turn in a random direction after reaching its’ destination.


Archer, TFB


 The Dumdum Bullet ability: fixed a bug that prevented the explosion when firing with the Counterattack and Snug Fit skills active.


Avant-garde, RAID


 Corrected the descriptions of upgrade #15-1.


Aphela, Nesher

notes.title: Micro-rebalance: Avant-garde and Açaí
notes.content:
The latest rebalance of version 0.22.0 introduced many changes. Two of these were a significant buff for Assault Avant-garde and a significant nerf for Medic Açaí. This Wednesday, November 22, we will slightly tweak some of these operators' characteristics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/db136482c0bcd77e16de68b6ea38a76ef697c747.jpg

1. Assault Avant-garde.
 
Players have learned to use Avant-garde as a long-distance fighter more efficiently than we anticipated. This was made possible by an improvement to linear upgrade #10.
 
We will slightly lower the primary weapon's rate of fire, and rebalance linear upgrade #10 itself. Now, the Longer Barrel upgrade will make the speed vs longer distance tradeoff more apparent. Avante-garde’s mobility will be gradually lowered, and not just while firing the primary weapon, and the slowdown will also last longer.

 We recommend using the Longer Barrel on suitable maps. The module can be turned on and off in the operator customization screen before a battle.
 
Primary weapon:
 
• Rate of fire reduced from 4 to 3.75 shots per second (it was 3.5 before the 0.22.0 update).
 
Linear upgrade #10 “Longer Barrel: Increased effective firing range”:
 
• Stability bonus decreased from 15% to 7%.
• "Movement speed reduced while using a rifle" changed to "Sprint speed and movement speed reduced by 0.5 m/s".
• Removed the movement speed decrease when firing the primary weapon while crouching.
 
 
2. Medic Açaí.
 
One of the main traits of this Brazilian Medic is his increased healing. Our stats have shown that the nerf decreased Açaí's healing effectiveness by a greater extent than we anticipated.
 
• Pneumatic Ampoule Launcher special gear: base healing per hit on a teammate increased. It is now 6 HP per hit instead of 5.

Almost all in-game Special Offers will be changed in the 0.22.0 update!

The current Special Offers distribution system has been in use, unchanged, for quite some time. It doesn’t factor in your wishes or account stats at all and presents you offers that aren't interesting to you.

The new Special Offers distribution system will be much more individualized. It will take multiple variables into account: your preferred game mode, how often you play it, your favorite class, and more.

notes.title: RE: Balance changes — update 0.22.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
Since the latest operator balance changes in version 0.21.1, we have been closely listening to your feedback and analyzing match statistics. We’ve drawn some conclusions and noted your requests. Now, we’re finally ready to tell you what’s going to change in version 0.22.0.
 
We paid especially close attention to the feedback from high-ranking players of the current ranked season, Arctic Wind.
 
The short version is in the video. Check it out, Recruit did his best. The details are in this article.
 
[previewyoutube=VsyugimFIsU;full][/previewyoutube] 
 
 
HITSCAN 

In the previous updates many operators received a buff in the form of instant bullets, also known as hitscan. But it eventually became apparent that, in deft hands, this makes certain operators TREMENDOUSLY more powerful than we’d initially thought.
 
For an average player, hitscan is just a slight buff. But for an experienced and talented player, it was huge.
 
Four operators are going to lose hitscan attacks in 0.22.0.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/a5189fff9a77489be025d24d46310897dfd33bc2.jpg

notes.title: Hotfix 0.21.1
notes.content:
During scheduled maintenance of Caliber servers, we implemented a number of changes and fixes to the game.

GENERAL CHANGES


 Decreased the size of the Heavy Metal Battle Pass emblem on the store’s banner.
 Fixed a bug that caused the game client to freeze if the last operator standing died to a grenade explosion.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused operators to not be displayed during replays.
 Hello from Hong Kong Execution: removed excess blur.
 Stay Vigilant Emote: Reworked and improved performance.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the mode’s name and battle time from appearing on the battle stats screen.
 Ranked Battles: Fixed a bug that caused the lack of activity penalty message to stay on screen after reading it.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused operators’ markers to drift to one side.
 Gamepads: Fixed a bug that caused aim assist to work incorrectly and drift away from the target if aiming while moving.
 Gamepads: Added aim assist for Medics Miguel and Açaí’s Special gear.
 Gamepads: Fixed a bug that allowed players to move with an open Score screen (TAB).


Threshold Mode:


 Added the Picks and Bans stage.
 To access the mode, players need to have at least three Level 10+ operators of the same role on their account.
 Friendly fire is enabled.
 The Recruits are unavailable.


More on these changes.

OPERATORS

General changes:


 Marksmen Vagabond, Archer, Eima and Komar: Fixed a bug that caused the damage upon hitting an enemy to display incorrectly.
 Marksmen Komar, Sokol, Kurt, Archer, Vagabond, Eima and Busel: Fixed errors in the damage reduction chart.


BOPE

Medic Açaí


 Pneumatic Ampoule Launcher special gear: Fixed display issues with the reticle.

notes.title: Update 0.21.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c1f9d2eeb6d348666fc5ba2fce561fbf06f112f9.jpg

Today we released an update 0.21.1 for Caliber.

The update features the Heavy Metal Battle Pass with Legendary Outfits for Jiaolong, a major operator rebalance, a new mission for the Palm Road map and a rebalance of its PvP version, partial gamepad support, bug fixes and more.

Also, we lowered the prices for the majority of items both on the website and in the game client. On Steam, Coins became cheaper as well.

You can find the complete list of changes in our patch note. See you on the battlefield!

notes.content:

Are you ready for a rebalance? Because this time it's really big!

We have adjusted the gameplay for not just one, but two classes: Assaults and Marksmen using bolt-action rifles. While the former will be debuffed in their survivability, the latter will receive a significant buff.

Smoke grenades will become more useful and plentiful. Also, upgrades to tactical flashlights and laser sights will increase accuracy when hip-firing.

notes.title: 0.21.0 update: patch note
notes.content:
We are launching a new marathon called New Horizons that features the updated rating system. The main reward of the marathon will be the Beluga Legendary Outfits for the GROM collection. There is a new game mode called Threshold and a new map called Polar Station as well as a number of bug fixes.

GENERAL CHANGES


 The New Horizons Marathon has started.
 Added GROM Legendary Outfits: Beluga. These can be obtained with the New Horizons marathon currency until August 16.
 Added the Threshold game mode.
 Added the Polar Station map.
 The Army Surplus Container objective has been made easier to complete. It now requires 3 victories per day instead of 5.
 Added the dynamic nav mesh for robots, drones and bots. They are now able to travel more efficiently and through previously inaccessible routes.
 The beta test for the User Battle game mode has begun.
 The matchmaking system has been improved: additional filters have been added for account levels (above and below Level 25) and team composition.

notes.title: Changes in the Prestige mechanics
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c5f1c74e935c23320ca7600e213eee959c3ab04c.jpg

0.20.2 will be the next Caliber version. We are ready to share some details!

In this update, we are going to change the way Prestige works. The first activation and subsequent Prestige leveling up will no longer reset operators’ progress. Your operator shall retain all their upgrades. 

Activation of each Prestige level costs 420,000 Credits. It is the same as the total cost of leveling up an operator. Apart from Credits, in order to raise the Prestige level, one has to earn 120,000 XP on the chosen operator.

Also, we have changed the rewards a little. The Extra XP bonus will only be awarded upon reaching the first level of Prestige. By reaching Prestige level 5, you will acquire a unique Superiority Emote.

In the article, we will tell more about the changes we've made and explain why we've made them.

"Additional XP” contains bonus XP from Boosters, Legendary Outfits, Premium and Medals. If you hover over the number of XP any of your teammates earned, you will also see the details.

notes.title: STEAM Q&A
notes.content:
I ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT IN CALIBER. WILL I BE ABLE TO PLAY VIA STEAM?
Yes.
[olist]
 All you have to do is download the game from Steam, launch it and log in.
 Next, you have to enter your login and password credentials of the account you registered on playcaliber.com.
 Done. Your Caliber account is now connected to your Steam account. Your progress and items are safe.
[/olist]
[previewyoutube=YjuPm2B9DJI;full][/previewyoutube]

IF I CREATE A NEW ACCOUNT INSTEAD OF CONNECTING AN OLD ONE, WILL I BE ABLE TO DISCONNECT THE NEW ONE AND CONNECT THE OLD ONE?
No. After creating a new Caliber account on Steam, the new account will be forever connected to the Steam account.

Please bear in mind that account creation/connection cannot be reversed.

CAN I DISCONNECT MY CALIBER ACCOUNT FROM STEAM?
No. If you don’t like playing via Steam, you can download the game from playcaliber. com and play the usual way.

DO I HAVE TO DOWNLOAD THE GAME FROM SCRATCH TO PLAY ON STEAM?
Yes, to start playing on Steam you have to:
[olist]
 Find Caliber in the Steam store.
 Press «Play» on the game’s page.[/olist]

CAN I SWITCH TO STEAM LATER?
Yes. You can still play Caliber you downloaded from our website and connect your account to Steam later.

IS CALIBER FROM THE WEBSITE ANY DIFFERENT FROM THE STEAM VERSION?
No. The website and Steam versions of the game are the same. They will receive updates simultaneously.

WHILE PLAYING ON STEAM, WILL I BE MATCHED ONLY WITH THE PLAYERS WHO PLAY ON STEAM TOO?
In battles, players are matched from all platforms. All players, whether they play via the launcher or Steam, will play together.

WILL STEAM’S SOCIAL SYSTEM BE INTEGRATED? FOR EXAMPLE, WILL I BE ABLE TO SEE A FRIEND WHO IS PLAYING IN SHOWDOWN?
For now, there is no such thing in the game. In future, we will try to use all opportunities that Steam offers.

WILL THERE BE STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS?
Yes. We are working on a significant list of achievements including the ones with hidden completion conditions.

WILL I BE ABLE TO PARTICIPATE IN THE STEAM EVENT BY PLAYING CALIBER VIA THE LAUNCHER?
No. Tasks can be completed only by playing on Steam.

WHAT WILL HAPPEN IF I ADD CALIBER TO STEAM VIA «ADD A NON-STEAM GAME TO MY LIBRARY» OPTION?
In this case, the game will be launched via the launcher and you will not be able to enjoy the advantages the Steam launch presents.

IF I PRESS «PLAY» ON STEAM, WILL IT START THE LAUNCHER OR THE LOGIN SCREEN?

If you connect your Steam account to your Caliber account, you will not see the launcher or the login screen. You will be redirected to your HQ menu.

I BOUGHT AN ITEM WHILE PLAYING ON STEAM. WILL I BE ABLE TO USE IT IF I LAUNCH THE GAME VIA THE LAUNCHER?
Yes. It’s the same account.

WILL I BE ABLE TO SEE HOW MANY HOURS I HAVE SPENT IN CALIBER IN TOTAL IF I CONNECT MY ACCOUNT TO STEAM?
No. Steam shows the number of hours you played only on Steam.

WILL MY STEAM FRIENDS LIST BE SYNCHRONIZED WITH MY IN-GAME FRIENDS LIST?
No.

WILL I BE ABLE TO INVITE TO MY FIRETEAM OR RECEIVE INVITES VIA STEAM?
Yes. There will be «Invite through Steam» button in the Contacts section.
